svg.text: Finish: blue all over with Oxpho-Blue (gloves and glasses on)
1. Brighten the faces (220 roll, the seat kept flat);
wipe clean with alcohol; hold by the edges only.
2. Swab Oxpho-Blue over every face, into the holes
and the thread; 60 s wet, wipe nearly dry, burnish
3. Thin coats again for a darker blue; then oil.
After: a 1/4-20 screw still runs through the tap; the {{cad.mounting_hole_1_dia_min_in:.3dot}} pin gauge into each hole.
